elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: Section 13.5 expressly requires Customer to pay the Termination for Convenience Fee as liquidated damages.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: The only amount characterized as liquidated damages is the Termination for Convenience Fee, which applies upon specified early terminations.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The fee equals three times the average monthly Fees payable during the three months before the Effective Date of Termination.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 13.5 expressly states that the Termination for Convenience Fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer under the Agreement.
